story_description: Persist themes on disk and apply them through a central manager.
task_description: The app needs a central coordinator to track the active theme, apply it to DSColors, handle theme switching with animation, and observe theme changes reactively.
atom_description: The app needs a central coordinator to track the active theme, apply it to DSColors, handle theme switching with animation, and observe theme changes reactively.
problem_statement: The app needs a central coordinator to track the active theme, apply it to DSColors, handle theme switching with animation, and observe theme changes reactively.
scope_in: @Observable manager for active theme; theme application logic; animated theme switching; environment injection
Implement ThemeManager.swift according to the problem statement and functional requirements.
scope_out: Theme persistence (ThemeStore); theme editing UI; settings UI
Exclude work assigned to other atoms or features in this epic.
assumptions: ThemeProfile, ThemeColors, ThemeStore exist
@Observable macro is available (Swift 5.9+)
DSColors can accept runtime overrides

functional_requirements: `applyTheme(_ theme: ThemeProfile, animated: Bool)` - Switch active theme
`resolvedColors: DSColors` - Current theme colors merged with system
Apply theme colors to DSColors and update environment values.
Animate theme transitions using the animation parameters in the spec.
Publish current theme changes for views to react.
nonfunctional_requirements: No UI flicker during theme application
implementation_steps: Implement init loading from AppStorage + ThemeStore
Add environment key for SwiftUI injection
api_contracts: `ThemeManager.loadActiveTheme()` - Async load from persistence on app launch
event_contracts: Theme change triggers SwiftUI re-render via @Observable
ui_states: No UI state; this atom is a data model or service component.
UI rendering is handled by view atoms that consume this component.
ui_interactions: No direct UI interactions; behavior is driven by callers.
Public methods are invoked by views or managers when needed.
ui_copy: No user-facing strings are introduced by this atom.
Any internal log text must avoid sensitive data.
edge_cases: Active theme ID not found (deleted) - fall back to Nebula
Apply same theme twice - no-op, skip animation
App launched with corrupted theme store - fall back to Nebula
failure_modes: Theme load failure - use Nebula default, log error
If persistence fails, log an error and keep the previous value.
rollback_plan: Remove ThemeManager; remove environment injection; app uses system colors only
